build_hf_headers: build headers dictionary for Hugging Face Hub API calls with authentication token and user-agent info
get_token_to_send: get the authorization token to send in a Hub request from explicit argument or local cache
_http_user_agent: format a user-agent string containing library name, version, and installed package information
_deduplicate_user_agent: deduplicate redundant information in a generated user-agent string
build_hf_headers_with_token: build Hugging Face Hub headers with an explicit token string for authenticated API requests
